name: setup
title: Advanced settings
about: The virtual camera, its size, extra cameras, video and microphone limits, and the Updates & About tab.

name: connection
title: Devices and connection
about: Pairing phones, picking a device and connecting to a phone over Wi-Fi or USB.

name: camera_control
title: Camera
about: Exposure, white balance, focus, lenses and the phone camera's other settings.
when_off: Without it there's no Camera card and the phone uses its own automatic settings.

name: browser_camera
title: Browser camera
about: Streaming from any device's web browser, by scanning a code.
when_off: Without it Browser camera isn't in the device picker and its card is gone too.

name: webcam
title: Webcams
about: Streaming from webcams and capture cards plugged into this computer.
when_off: Without it webcams aren't in the device picker and the Webcam card is gone too.

name: cinema
title: Cinema tools
about: Focus peaking, zebras, false colour, scopes, framing guides and a level on the preview, for judging focus, exposure, framing and a straight horizon.
when_off: Without it there's no Cinema tools card and the preview shows just the picture.

name: face_exposure
title: Expose for my face
about: Moves the phone's metering point to your face to keep you well lit whatever's behind you.
when_off: Without it there's no Expose for my face card and the phone meters the point you tap or the whole picture.

name: background
title: Background
about: Blurs the background behind you or swaps it for a picture.
when_off: Without it there's no Background card and the background stays as the camera sees it.

name: chroma_key
title: Chroma key
about: Swaps a green or blue screen behind you for a colour or a picture, with no download.
when_off: Without it there's no Chroma key card and a green screen stays green.

name: fun_pack
title: Fun pack
about: Silly effects: clones, an invisibility cloak, light painting, retro looks and datamosh.
when_off: Without it there's no Fun pack card and the picture has no effects.

name: privacy_blur
title: Privacy blur
about: Blurs the other people, everything but you, or puts the wait screen up when someone else walks in.
when_off: Without it there's no Privacy blur card and nothing gets hidden when someone walks in.

name: photos
title: Photos
about: Takes full-quality photos on the phone, RAW and the phone's Night mode included where it has them.
when_off: Without it there's no Photos card and no Take photo shortcut.

name: colour_grading
title: Colour grading
about: Colour wheels, curves and LUT files for the look of the picture.
when_off: Without it there's no Colour grading card and the picture keeps the camera's colours.

name: stream_output
title: Stream output
about: The resolution, frame rate and format of the stream.
when_off: Without it there's no Stream output card and streams use whatever size and format the phone picks.

name: transforms
title: Transforms
about: Zoom, pan, flip, rotate and stretch the picture.
when_off: Without it there's no Transforms card and the picture goes out exactly as the phone sends it.

name: framing
title: Auto framing
about: Zooms and pans to keep you in the picture as you move.
when_off: Without it there's no Auto framing card and the zoom stays where you put it.

name: desk
title: Desk and document mode
about: Straightens a sheet of paper you mark on the preview and can make the writing on it stand out.
when_off: Without it there's no Desk mode card and the picture stays the way the camera sees it.

name: name_tag
title: Name tag
about: Puts your name and pronouns in the corner of the picture.
when_off: Without it there's no Name tag card and nothing is drawn on the picture.

name: notes
title: Notes
about: Shows your notes on the phone's screen right under the camera, to read while looking people in the eye.
when_off: Without it there's no Notes card and the phone never shows notes.

name: composite
title: Several cameras in one picture
about: Puts the streams you run side by side or one inside another, out on one virtual camera.
when_off: Without it there's no One picture card and each stream only goes to its own camera.

name: microphone
title: Microphone
about: Using the phone's microphone on this computer.
when_off: Without it there's no Microphone card or Mute in the tray menu and Telescope doesn't make a virtual microphone.

name: presets
title: Presets
about: Saving and loading groups of settings with one click.
when_off: Without it there's no Presets button in the header (your saved presets aren't deleted).

name: qr_reader
title: QR code reader
about: Copies a QR code you hold up to the camera, or the password from a Wi-Fi code.
when_off: Without it there's no QR code card and codes in the picture are left alone.

name: preview
title: Preview
about: The live picture in the middle of the window, and the camera on/off button under it.
when_off: Without it the window doesn't show the picture but apps using the virtual camera still get it.

name: onboarding
title: Setup guide
about: The step by step checklist shown until the first stream works.
when_off: Without it the setup checklist never shows, not even when nothing is set up yet.

name: monitoring
title: Monitoring
about: The phone's battery and temperature, with warnings when they get low or high.
when_off: Without it there's no Phone card and nothing warns you about a low battery or a hot phone.

name: updates
title: Updates
about: Checking for new versions of Telescope and installing them.

name: wait_screen
title: Wait screen
about: The picture apps see on the virtual camera while nothing is streaming.
when_off: Without it Wait screen isn't in Settings and between streams apps might see a black picture or nothing at all.

name: on_air
title: On Air sign
about: Shows the people around you that you're on a call, on another device's screen or through a smart home light.
when_off: Without it there's no On Air tab in Settings and no sign or webhook.

name: shortcuts
title: Keyboard shortcuts
about: Keys for Telescope's controls, including ones that work in other apps.
when_off: Without it no shortcut does anything and Keyboard shortcuts isn't in Settings (your shortcuts are kept for when it's back).

name: startup
title: Start and stop by itself
about: Opening Telescope when you sign in, and Automatic streaming.
when_off: Without it Automatic streaming stops and both it and the sign-in option leave Settings. Telescope still opens at sign-in if it did before.
